title: Michelle McDaid (The Leading Place) — 'Your optimism is a fuel that has to be burned to keep the engine running'
summary: Michelle McDaid — founder of Ireland's The Leading Place — listens to the Adam Grant Rethinking episode with Eric on a beach in Rathmullan, Co. Donegal, and publishes a five-point reflection: optimism as fuel that has to burn, temporary organizations led by temporary leaders owned by temporary investors, human potential vs. hitting-the-number, Munger on incentives, and 'the market deciding' as often just powerful people arranging things to suit themselves.
blockquote: Your optimism - your belief in the possibility of a better future - is a fuel that has to be burned to keep the engine running.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on Adam Grant's Rethinking podcast, quoted by Michelle McDaid on LinkedIn
